vimentin <- seurat_old@assays$RNA$counts["Vimentin",] > 0.0

#pc <- codex@assays$RNA$counts["Pan-Cytokeratin",] > 0.0
sma <- codex@assays$RNA$counts["SMA",] > 0.0
melanA <- codex@assays$RNA$counts["MelanA",] > 0.0
vimentin <- codex@assays$RNA$counts["Vimentin",] > 0.0
k5 <- codex@assays$RNA$counts["Keratin 5",] > 0.0
fil <- codex@assays$RNA$counts["Filaggrin",] > 0.0
CD45 <- codex@assays$RNA$counts["CD45",] > 0.0

lineage_matrix <- as.data.frame(cbind(fil, melanA, k5, sma, vimentin))
upset(lineage_matrix * 1) # Multiplying by 1 converts TRUE/FALSE to 1/0

setwd("..")

## Including Plots


```{r, echo=FALSE}

codex1 <-codex

codex1 <- RunUMAP(codex1, reduction = "pca", dims=1:10, n.neighbors = 50, min.dist=0.3, spread=1)


Idents(codex1) <- 'skincelltype'

DimPlot(codex1, reduction = 'umap')
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
